standard-dialogue-without-book-o-piracy.npc: Arr? Be ye wantin' te go on account with our gang o' fillibusters?
The powder monkey be takin' a caulk after gettin' rowdy on bumboo, so there be plenty of room for ye.

standard-dialogue-without-book-o-piracy.player: I'll just be over here if you need me.

steps.npc: We gots grog and we gots food. Here, take a look.
Then stop takin' up me floor space!

options.text: I wanted to know where you got that harpoon hand.

steps.player: I wanted to know where you got that harpoon hand.

steps.npc: Well, if ye wants te hear the story, here goes.
See, I was walkin' along the docks one day, and this fierce storm blew up.
All of a sudden I turn an there, bearin' down on me is this albatross...

steps.player: Sorry to interrupt, but I would just like to clear something up.

steps.npc: What? I was just gettin' to the good bit.

steps.player: When I said 'I wanted to know where you got that harpoon hand', I meant where did you get it made, or buy it from?

steps.npc: If ye don't wants to hear the story then I ain't gonna tell ye!
